reason: The cited evidence shows that doping (N in HEA, Cu/Co in Pd) can shift the d-band center and improve durability/poisoning resistance, but it does not directly support the specific claim that Cu doping in PtPdRhRuIrOs will favor full ethanol oxidation to CO2 or enhance selectivity. The link between d-band shift and CO2 pathway is assumed, not evidenced.
premises: Doping a high-entropy alloy with a minor element induces local lattice strain
Local lattice strain shifts the surface d-band center
A d-band center shift moderates binding energies of ethanol oxidation intermediates
Moderated binding energies favor full oxidation to CO2 and reduce poisoning
These electronic changes enhance selectivity and durability
